creative_brief.central_tension: The stated horizon merely covers upfront capital before discounting.
creative_brief.concept: Use a five-year repayment ticket: annual net savings accumulate toward the capital price while the unresolved conditions stay visible.
alternatives: Vendor-quote markup, useful but too little evidence for a full deck
Gate map, useful for the ask but weaker at explaining economics
creative_brief.choice: Repayment ticket, with economics as the substantive organising device.
